Customer systems. Many of your staff spend the day serving customers, in a CRM, a ticketing portal or a phone app. WorkPulse can measure that work as customer time. Let's set it up.
Open Settings from the sidebar, then choose the Customer systems tab.
Type a name for the system, for example OsakaConnect, and choose whether it is a website or an application.
For a website, enter its domain, like crm dot osakaconnect dot com. Its subdomains are included automatically. For an application, enter its program name instead.
Choose the service it is used for: Visa, Ticketing, Insurance or Forex. This is required for websites. Then pick the departments that use it, or keep All departments.
Click Add. The system appears in the list. Then click Save customer systems to apply the change.
To change a system, click its name. To remove one, click the cross. The Service and Department filters help you find systems quickly.
From now on, time spent in these systems is shown as customer time in Productivity, broken down by system.
In Attendance, quiet time with no keyboard or mouse, while a customer system is open, for example during a customer call, counts towards the required working hours.
That's it. Your customer-facing staff are now measured by the work they really do.
